notes.title: Welcome to Phantomware 0 – A Nightmare You Can’t Wake Up From
notes.content:
[p]Hey folks,[/p][p]We’re incredibly excited (and honestly a bit nervous) to finally share [i]Phantomware 0[/i] with you — the first step into a story we’ve been quietly building, glitch by glitch, piece by broken piece.[/p][p]If you’re reading this, thank you. Whether you’ve already wishlisted the game (we see you 👀❤️) or just stumbled across this strange little horror experience out of curiosity — we’re really glad you're here.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]What is [i]Phantomware 0[/i]?[/h2][p][i]Phantomware 0[/i] is a short, narrative-driven psychological horror game set in a corrupted digital space — where memory, guilt, and identity are falling apart.[/p][p]You play as an unnamed figure inside a haunted machine, uncovering fragments of a larger story buried in the static. It’s glitchy. It’s personal. And it’s meant to leave a mark — even if it doesn’t shout to get your attention.[/p][p]This is Chapter 0 — a standalone prologue. Yes, it’s short, but it’s designed to be unsettling in a quiet, creeping way. The kind of horror that lingers.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Why We Made This[/h2][p]We’ve always loved horror that doesn’t rely on loud scares or cheap tricks. Horror that’s subtle. Introspective. The kind that unsettles you without fully explaining why.[/p][p]With [i]Phantomware 0[/i], we wanted to explore the feeling of being lost inside something broken — a machine, a memory, a version of yourself. It’s about systems that fail you. About ghosts that aren’t dead, just forgotten. About not knowing whether what you’re seeing is the glitch or the truth.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]What’s Next?[/h2][p]This is just the beginning.[/p][p]In the coming months, we’ll be:[/p][list][*][p]Sharing behind-the-scenes development and concept art[/p][/*][*][p]Diving deeper into the story and its themes[/p][/*][*][p]Breaking down how we’re blending analog horror with emotion and tech[/p][/*][*][p]Expanding this world for the full version of [i]Phantomware[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]This project means a lot to us. It’s weird. It’s rough around the edges. But it’s ours — and now it’s yours too.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Thank You[/h2][p]The support so far has been incredible. Every wishlist, comment, and share gives this game more room to grow.[/p][p]If you haven’t already, please consider Wishlisting [i]Phantomware 0[/i] on Steam. It helps more than you know.[/p][p]This isn’t just a game.
It’s a fracture.
And the deeper you go, the harder it is to come back.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Join the Community

[/url]
